name: Healthie
description: Healthie is an API-first electronic health record, scheduling, engagement, and practice-management platform for digital health organizations. Teams use it for patients, providers, appointments, forms, care plans, messaging, telehealth, billing, insurance, clinical records, programs, reporting, and operational workflows.
agentUseSummary: Add a dedicated Healthie user or service-account API key, plus the shard authorization ID only when Healthie assigned one, then choose which agents can use the complete current GraphQL API under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: HEALTHIE_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Healthie API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated Healthie user or service-account API key. Railway encrypts it and sends it only to api.gethealthie.com.

credentialRequirements.name: HEALTHIE_AUTHORIZATION_SHARD
credentialRequirements.label: Shard authorization ID (if Healthie assigned one)
credentialRequirements.helpText: Only accounts hosted on a Healthie data shard need this value; Healthie support supplies it.

capabilities.label: Read Healthie data
capabilities.description: Run bounded GraphQL queries permitted by the customer-owned Healthie API key.

capabilities.label: Manage Healthie workflows
capabilities.description: Run bounded GraphQL mutations permitted by the customer-owned Healthie API key.

allowed.label: Query Healthie GraphQL
allowed.description: Run one bounded, non-introspection GraphQL query against Healthie's fixed production API origin.

approvalRequired.label: Mutate Healthie GraphQL
approvalRequired.description: Run one bounded Healthie GraphQL mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: GraphQL queries run directly; every mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected API-key-authorized Healthie query or mutation runs without Relay per-action approval; connection ownership, fixed origin, bounds, audits, secret non-exposure, Healthie user permissions, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts separate bounded GraphQL query and mutation wrappers and attaches the encrypted Healthie API key server-side.
Railway mounts separate bounded GraphQL query and mutation wrappers and attaches the encrypted Healthie API key server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer needs Healthie API access, a dedicated user or service-account API key, any assigned shard authorization ID, representative non-production data, and an authorized test account. Public Harbor distribution additionally requires Healthie's security review, commercial agreement, technical review, and partner approval.
providerSetup.nextAction: Apply to the Healthie Harbor with Relay's healthcare security and integration materials, obtain sandbox and authorized production API access, connect a dedicated key, then verify current-user health, queries, Safe mutation denial, approved or Dangerous-mode mutations, redaction, rate limits, key replacement, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Healthie documents per-user API keys, service-account API keys, Basic authorization with AuthorizationSource API, optional AuthorizationShard, user-bound permissions, and programmatic per-user key creation by arrangement with Healthie.
Healthie fixes production GraphQL traffic at https://api.gethealthie.com/graphql and provides a separate non-PHI sandbox at staging-api.gethealthie.com.
Healthie documents an explicit Healthie-GraphQL-API-Version header, additive schema evolution, and the current 2026-01-01 version.
Healthie states that external developers receive the same GraphQL API used by its own clients across engagement, provider management, telehealth, billing, EHR, and other platform workflows.
Healthie's Harbor requires accepted partners to complete a security review, commercial agreement, and technical review; application does not guarantee admission.
